note: Diagnostic timings add callback overhead and are not comparable with primary latency samples. Work counts are collected separately from phase timing: owner visits/renders/cache reuse, key-index visits, and actual DOM host method mutations. totalUpdateMedianMs reuses the matching benchmark sample (programmatic click through microtask settle); outsideRootFlushMedianMs is the paired total minus root.flush. Dispatch path markers and structural gate/bail reasons cover the full-reconcile fallback as well as the keyed-owner path. mountScenario drains the initial row-selection update before the timed loop so it cannot batch with a structural update.
